origin: read-only adapter over shared synthetic fixture corpus
description: Pins the T10 test harness to all shared v1.0.1 business-question cases. Inputs are materialized by loading strict Business snapshots and event type codes from the frozen dataset; no model or database output is used as a label.

scenario_adaptations.sparse-export-country: Remove the stored skipped answer to exercise the unanswered sparse-profile branch; skipped behavior is covered independently by skipped-is-not-no.
scenario_adaptations.sparse-export-vendor: Remove the stored skipped answer to exercise a fresh question proposal.
scenario_adaptations.b-budget-one-question: Pass request budget 1; all other scenario budgets are 10 and are still capped by snapshot preferences.
scenario_adaptations.question-preference-suppression: Set alternative_route in the explicitly supplied snapshot preference for this local test case.

expected_properties: Read from the frozen shared case list and asserted by named per-case properties in tests/test_t10_business.py. They are provisional property expectations, not predicted model outputs.
limitations: This index materializes test inputs by applying the documented scenario adaptations to frozen snapshots; it is not an owner-produced profile.
No model output is used as a label; all case expectations remain provisional pending independent review.
hash_method: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false) after omitting the data_hash field.
